The '''ceiling function''', often denoted by $\lceil \ \rceil$, finds the smallest integer no smaller than a [[real number]].

{{Hidden example}}
$$
\lceil 4.5 \rceil = 5 \\
\lceil \pi \rceil = 4 \\
\lceil -1 \rceil = -1 \\
$$
{{End hidden}}

== Formal definition ==

$$
\lceil \ \rceil: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{Z},\\
\forall x \in \mathbb{R},\, \lceil x \rceil =
\begin{cases}
x, & x \in \mathbb{Z},\\
\min(\{z\in \mathbb{Z}| z>x\}), & \text{elsewise}.
\end{cases}
$$
